text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district stands at 10.8 €/m², up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the last five years, placing the market 22nd of the 37 most expensive German cities. A typical 60 m² unit costs 648 € per month, with a rent‑burden of 12.5 % for two residents, while listings stay on the market for about 29 days and only 24 % are let within a week, reflecting a balanced market and a low vacancy of 1.6 %.

Affordability is pressured: asking rents are roughly 50 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 7.21 €/m², and mortgage rates sit at 4.09 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.0 €/m² and 11.56 €/m², a change of 4.7 % from today.
